sources.title: Qwen2-VL Model Finetuning - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository contains code for finetuning the Qwen2-VL vision-language model on custom datasets using HuggingFace datasets. It includes a Gradio web interface for easy interaction and a Python script for command-line execution.
